name: TC_D02_DeletedProductAbsentFromCart
description:
After deleting a product, asserts two critical outcomes:
  (1) data.products list does not contain the deleted product id.
  (2) data.grand_total is non-null and >= 0.
Verifies the delete actually removes the item from the cart state, not just returns a success code.
